byCarZh: 國道 6 號愛蘭交流道下 -> 左轉往日月潭方向（台 21 線） -> 行駛約 8 分鐘見桃米生態村指示牌右轉 -> 順山語專屬指標上行即可抵達。
導航建議設定：「山語 Villa」或經緯度座標，山路均已鋪設柏油路面，雙向會車平整安全。
byCarEn: Take National Freeway 6 to Ailan Interchange -> Turn left toward Sun Moon Lake (Provincial Hwy 21) -> Drive ~8 mins to Taomi Village -> Follow Shan Yu Villa signs.
GPS Navigation: Enter 'Shan Yu Villa'. The access road is fully paved and suitable for all standard passenger vehicles.
transportation.byPublicZh: 搭乘高鐵至台中站，轉乘「台灣好行日月潭線」於桃米坑站下車，山莊可提供預約制尊榮專車接駁服務（需於入住前 3 天預訂）。
transportation.byPublicEn: Take THSR to Taichung Station, transfer to the Sun Moon Lake Shuttle Bus to Taomi Station. Complimentary private VIP shuttle is available upon reservation (3 days in advance).

attractions.descZh: 全台最負盛名的絕美高山湖泊，推薦體驗全球十大最美自行車道、向山遊客中心與專屬包船遊湖。
attractions.descEn: Taiwan's iconic alpine lake. Explore the world-renowned lake cycling trail and Xiangshan Visitor Center.

attractions.nameZh: 紙教堂新故鄉見學園區
attractions.descZh: 由 58 根高壓紙柱構建的現代建築奇蹟，結合生態池與在地手作陶藝、有機咖啡工坊。
attractions.descEn: An architectural marvel constructed of 58 paper tubes, surrounded by rich wetland ecosystems and local pottery shops.

attractions.descZh: 歐式古典巴洛克城堡莊園，世界金牌巧克力工坊，提供沉浸式巧克力手作 DIY 體驗。
attractions.descEn: European Baroque style castle estate with world-champion chocolates and interactive DIY workshops.
